description: Repaint this coastal strip as one continuous shoreline. On the left is a dark volcanic rocky headland with a few lava veins; on the right is open teal sea with small white whitecaps. Remove the vertical band of stippled blue-and-dark noise running down the middle and replace it with a natural coast: dark rock and small beaches meeting pale turquoise shallows that fade smoothly into the open teal sea. Keep the exact same colors and pixel-art style as the surrounding water and rock; no straight vertical line and no speckled noise column should remain.
